# Sea Dog Marine

> Sea Dog Marine is a marine cleaning and maintenance company serving waterfront property owners in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Manatee counties, Florida (Tampa Bay). Call or text 727-699-4920 for a free video inspection.

## Key facts
- Business name: Sea Dog Marine
- Phone (call or text): 727-699-4920
- Service area: Pinellas County, Hillsborough County and Manatee County, Florida
- Cities: St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Largo, Seminole, Dunedin, Tarpon Springs, Palm Harbor, Treasure Island, St. Pete Beach, Madeira Beach, Indian Rocks Beach, Redington Shores, Belleair, Gulfport, Tierra Verde, Oldsmar, Safety Harbor, Tampa, Davis Islands, Harbour Island, Apollo Beach, Ruskin, Gibsonton, Rocky Point, Westshore, South Tampa, Riverview, Town 'n' Country, Bradenton, Palmetto, Anna Maria Island, Holmes Beach, Bradenton Beach, Anna Maria, Cortez, Longboat Key, Ellenton, Terra Ceia, Snead Island
- Removes: algae, barnacles, oysters, mold and marine growth
- Free video inspections: text a video or photos for a same day quote
- Hours: Monday to Friday: 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday: 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM

## Services
- [Dock Cleaning](https://www.seadogmarinefl.com/dock-cleaning.html): Dock cleaning in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Manatee counties. Barnacle and oyster removal from decking and framing. Text for a free video inspection.
- [Seawall Cleaning](https://www.seadogmarinefl.com/seawall-cleaning.html): Seawall cleaning in Tampa Bay, Florida. Barnacle and oyster removal from the wall face and cap so cracks show. Text for a free video inspection.
- [Piling Cleaning](https://www.seadogmarinefl.com/piling-cleaning.html): Piling cleaning in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Manatee counties. Barnacle and oyster removal from wood and concrete pilings. Text for a free inspection.
- [Boat Lift Cleaning](https://www.seadogmarinefl.com/boat-lift-cleaning.html): Boat lift cleaning in Tampa Bay, FL. Barnacle and oyster removal from cradles, bunks and beams so the lift runs smoothly. Text for a free video inspection.
- [Dock Ladder Cleaning](https://www.seadogmarinefl.com/ladder-cleaning.html): Dock ladder cleaning in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Manatee. Barnacle, oyster and slime removal so ladders are safe. Text for a free video inspection.
- [Piling and Dock Protection Wraps](https://www.seadogmarinefl.com/piling-wraps.html): Piling wraps in Tampa Bay, FL. Clean wood pilings first, then protect them from marine borers and rot. Text 727-699-4920 for a free video inspection.
- [Maintenance Plans and Storm Prep](https://www.seadogmarinefl.com/maintenance-plans.html): Waterfront maintenance plans in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Manatee counties. Scheduled cleaning plus storm prep. Text for a free video inspection today.
